driver: STM32N6 general-purpose timer (TIM2) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 54 (TIM2/TIM3/TIM4/TIM5) + memory map p.181
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.54 TIM2-5 register interface + memory map p.181 (TIM2 secure base 0x50000000)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the TIM benchmark work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure TIM2 (stm32n6xx.h), internal clock

Counter enable/disable and enable query (TIMx_CR1.CEN); counter mode (TIMx_CR1.DIR with TIMx_CR1.CMS), one-pulse mode (OPM), auto-reload preload (ARPE), clock division (CKD), update request source (URS) and update event enable (UDIS)

Counter (TIMx_CNT), prescaler (TIMx_PSC) and auto-reload (TIMx_ARR) write and read; update event generation (TIMx_EGR.UG); update flag query and clear (TIMx_SR.UIF, rc_w0); update interrupt enable/disable (TIMx_DIER.UIE) (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)

Out of scope: HAL API, capture/compare channels and outputs, slave mode and triggers, encoder mode, DMA, the other interrupts and flags, dithering, UIF remapping, TIM3/TIM4/TIM5, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_tim.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 TIM LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects TIM2_S at 0x50000000).

scope.note: counter enable and time base configuration, counter/prescaler/auto-reload, update event, update flag and interrupt enable
